page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines inside an engraved woodcut border; no margin text. Reading order: the Greek title lines, then the Latin title lines, then the imprint at the foot of the frame.

page.notes: Engraved woodcut border with figures (top: satyr-like figures, central putto; sides: a female figure with child on the left, a bearded male figure with a club on the right; bottom: a grotesque mask in a cartouche). The Greek and roman numeral lines are as printed. A small red pen mark appears at the upper right inside the frame and is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse is faint and is not transcribed.
